title: ITVX / Drama through spacing
slide_intent: Use spacing, scale and placement to build emotional progression over a portrait, because letterforms shape the tone and reading emphasis of a message.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen a recognizable voice across different programme moods.
demonstration: A close portrait of a tearful woman carries widely spaced words at separate heights, including ROMANCE and BETRAYAL. The lower yellow word is cropped at both sides.
practical_value: Use spacing, scale and placement to build emotional progression over a portrait.

content_islands.name: Text levels
